definition: Thermosphere crosswind at the GOCE satellite location
description: This product contains thermosphere crosswind at the GOCE satellite location, derived from GOCE accelerometer (non-gravitational acceleration) data by Delft University of Technology. It is the GOCE counterpart of the CHAMP, GRACE and GRACE-FO crosswind products (CH_WND_ACC_2_, GR_WNDxACC_2_, GF_WNDxACC_2_) and accompanies the GOCE thermosphere density product GO_DNS_ACC_2_.
